faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Yes. No commitment, cancel in one tap from settings.
faq.q2: What happens to my photos if I cancel?
faq.a2: They stay. Forever. Downgrading to Free restricts new uploads if you're over 5 GB, but never hides or deletes existing memories.
faq.a3: Yes. Invite-only. No ads. No AI training. No data selling. Your photos are stored privately and never leave our servers.
faq.a4: No. Joining a circle is always free. Only circle owners pay.
faq.q5: What counts toward the 5 GB limit?
faq.a5: Photos and videos you upload. Memories shared by other members don't count against your quota.
faq.q6: Can I try Pro before paying?
faq.a6: Yes — every new circle gets a free 14-day Pro trial when you upload your first memory. No credit card needed.
